Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. The five warnings are the ones the Gymnasium family bridge produces: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only arms the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.index, seed twice); declaring actions to add units would expose undescribed reset inputs and fail G6/G8, as the exemplar records. NOT COVERED: the real 240 x 256 x 3 NES frame and the emulator itself; the fake returns a 24 x 32 x 3 placeholder downscale and does not emulate the CPU, PPU, mappers, RAM, controllers or audio, and it was never compared with an upstream run (the native extension and a ROM are not available to the gate). NOT COVERED: snapshot/restore, because NESEnv has dump_state/load_state (nes_py/nes_env.py:214-225) but the gymnasium bridge only detects get_state/set_state. The package is model-authored and unreviewed; no human review, hardware run or device validation is claimed. The clone at robots/kautenja/nes-py was not modified.
